question: Which state does the noted Sindhi Sarangi player Lakha Khan belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noted **Sindhi Sarangi player Lakha Khan hails from the state of Rajasthan, India**.
 
• Specifically,** he is from the village of Raneri in the Jodhpur district**. 
 
• Lakha Khan belongs to the **Manganiar community**, a traditional musician caste from Rajasthan known for their contributions to Indian folk music. 
 
• Lakha Khan has not only performed extensively across India but has also represented Indian folk music on international stages, including the United States and Europe
